demo: We offer a demo session before you commit! Pay a small demo fee and experience the quality of our tutors firsthand.
greeting: Hello! Welcome to VidhyaGharSe. How can I help you today?
goodbye: Goodbye! Feel free to come back anytime. Have a great day!
thanks: You're welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with?
about: VidhyaGharSe is a managed tuition marketplace connecting parents and students with expert tutors for home and online tuition across India.
find_tutor: We will help you find the perfect tutor! Please register as a parent and share your requirements. Visit /find-tutor to get started.
online_tuition: We offer live 1-on-1 online tuition from the comfort of your home. Sessions are conducted via video call with verified tutors.
pricing: Our tuition plans start at Rs.499. Visit /pricing for full details.
subjects_maths: We have expert maths tutors for all grades K-12. Register now to get matched with a tutor near you!
phonics: We offer a dedicated Phonics course for young learners to build strong reading and pronunciation skills. Visit /courses/phonics.
maths_ability: Our Maths Ability course helps students build strong mental math and problem-solving skills. Visit /courses/maths-ability.
city_bengaluru: We have verified tutors across Bengaluru. Register to find the best tutor near your locality!
city_mumbai: We have verified tutors across Mumbai. Register to find the best tutor near your locality!
city_pune: We have verified tutors across Pune. Register to find the best tutor near your locality!
city_delhi: We have verified tutors across Delhi. Register to find the best tutor near your locality!
refund: Refunds are processed as per policy. Contact support with your booking ID.
cancel_booking: To cancel your booking please contact us at support@vidhyagharse.com or call us with your booking ID. We will process it promptly.
reschedule: To reschedule a class please contact your assigned tutor through the platform or reach our support team.
tutor_earning: Tutors on VidhyaGharSe earn competitive monthly payouts based on assigned sessions. Premium tutors get priority leads and higher earnings!
contact: You can reach us at support@vidhyagharse.com or via WhatsApp. We are available Monday to Saturday 9am to 6pm.
working_hours: We are available Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.
privacy: Your data is encrypted and never shared.
board_cbse: We have tutors experienced in CBSE curriculum for all classes from 1 to 12. Register now to get matched!
board_icse: We have tutors experienced in ICSE curriculum. Register now to get matched with the right tutor!
class_primary: We have tutors for Class 1 to 5 covering all subjects. Register to get the best match for your child!
class_secondary: We have tutors for Class 9 and 10 for all subjects including exam preparation. Register to get matched!
tutor_quality: Yes all tutors are verified and performance tracked.
attendance: Tutor attendance is tracked via geo-location for home tuition sessions to ensure accountability and transparency.
complaint: We take complaints seriously. Please email us at support@vidhyagharse.com with your booking ID and we will resolve it within 24 hours.
feedback: We love feedback! Share your experience at /feedback or email us. Your input helps us serve you better.
otp_login: You can log in securely using your mobile number and OTP verification. Visit /login to get started.
discount: We occasionally offer discounts and promotional offers. Subscribe to our newsletter or follow us on social media to stay updated!
how_it_works: It is simple! 1. Register as parent. 2. Share your requirements. 3. Pay demo fee. 4. We assign a verified tutor. 5. Demo class. 6. Continue if satisfied!
not_understood: I am sorry I could not understand that. Could you please rephrase? You can also contact us at support@vidhyagharse.com for help.
tutor_timing: The number of sessions per week depends on your plan. Typically 3 to 5 sessions per week are recommended.
invoice: You can download your invoice from the parent dashboard after logging in at /parent/dashboard.
careers: We are growing! Check our open positions at /careers. We look for passionate educators and tech professionals.
partner: Interested in partnering with VidhyaGharSe? Email us at partners@vidhyagharse.com and our team will get back to you within 48 hours.
terms: You can read our Terms and Conditions at /terms. Feel free to ask if you have any specific questions.
app_download: Our mobile app is coming soon! Stay tuned for the VidhyaGharSe app on Android and iOS.
technical_issue: We apologize for the inconvenience! Please try refreshing the page or clearing your browser cache. Contact support if the issue persists.
group_class: Currently we focus on personalized 1-on-1 tuition. Group classes may be available for certain courses. Contact us for details.
sibling_booking: Yes! You can register multiple children under one parent account. Each child will be matched with the most suitable tutor.
language_hindi: We have tutors for Hindi medium students too. Mention your medium of instruction during registration.
language_telugu: We have tutors for Telugu medium students and Telugu language classes across Telangana and AP.
special_needs: We have empathetic tutors experienced with special needs students. Please contact us directly so we can find the best match for your child.
home_tuition: We offer home tuition at your doorstep in major cities.
parent_register: Visit /parent-register and complete the simple registration process.
